question: The Union Budget 2025-26 states that total number of students in 23 IITs has increased 100 per cent from 65,000 to 1.35 lakh in the past ______ years.
solution:
The correct answer is __**10 years**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 __ 
• The **Union Budget 2025-26** highlights the significant growth in the total number of students enrolled in **23 Indian Institutes of Technology (IITs)**. 
• The number of students has increased **100%**, growing from **65,000 to 1.35 lakh** over a period of **10 years**. 
• This growth demonstrates the **rapid expansion** and infrastructure development of IITs, as well as the increased focus on **higher education** in India. 
• The **10-year period** indicates a consistent focus on capacity building in premier institutions between the years **2015 and 2025.** 
• The increase in student intake also reflects the **government’s commitment** to enhancing access to quality education in the field of science, engineering, and technology. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 __ 
• **Indian Institutes of Technology (IITs):** 
• IITs are **autonomous public technical universities** under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Education, Government of India. 
• As of 2025, there are **23 IITs** spread across India, offering undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs in various engineering, technology, and scientific disciplines. 
• They are globally recognized for their **academic excellence** and contribute significantly to **research and innovation.** 
• **Expansion of IITs:** 
• The government has introduced **new IITs** in locations such as **Tirupati, Palakkad, Bhilai, Jammu, Dharwad**, and others under the **11th and 12th Five-Year Plans.** 
• This expansion aims to improve access to **quality education** for students from diverse regions of India. 
• **Focus on Education in Union Budgets:** 
• Union Budgets in recent years have emphasized **education reforms**, including increased funding for **higher education** and **research programs.** 
• Initiatives like **National Education Policy (NEP) 2020** and funding schemes for IITs reflect this focus. 
• **Important IIT Statistics:** 
• IITs collectively enroll students based on the **Joint Entrance Examination (JEE Advanced)** and are considered among the most competitive institutions globally. 
• In 2025, the **student-to-faculty ratio** in IITs is being improved to ensure **better academic support and mentorship.** 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
 
• **Global Rankings:** IITs are consistently ranked in global university rankings such as **QS World University Rankings** and **Times Higher Education Rankings.** 
• **Research and Development:** IITs are at the forefront of **technological innovation**, contributing to fields like **artificial intelligence, renewable energy, and biotechnology.** 
• **Government Initiatives:** Programs like **HEFA (Higher Education Financing Agency)** and **Prime Minister’s Research Fellowship** aim to strengthen IITs' research capabilities.
